# Notification action telemetry separates ordered configuration from dispatch counts

MailGlue records mail.biff.alert.enabled_actions as an ordered string list. The usage metric is a labeled counter whose labels identify concrete actions in MailNotificationManager. The callback increments the counter before runAction, so a count does not prove the operation completed. Review asks for the label meaning to be documented and rejects replacing the stored comma-separated format with spaces. Later accepted IDs name behaviors, such as mark-as-read and delete, instead of historical action1/action2 positions. No telemetry or action was executed.

Scope: Notification action metrics.
